text: Which equation is the affinely parametrized geodesic equation (parameter τ) as written in this book?
explanation: The book writes the geodesic (auto-parallel) equation as d²xᵘ/dτ² + Γᵘ_νρ (dxᵛ/dτ)(dxᵖ/dτ) = 0, equivalently ∇_γ̇ γ̇ = 0. It reduces to d²xᵘ/dτ² = 0 only in normal coordinates where Γ vanishes at the point, not in every system (choice 1). The Riemann tensor governs geodesic deviation, not the geodesic itself (choice 2), and the connection term carries a plus sign (choice 3 has the wrong sign).
